name: Warlock Path
summary: Path Benefit Seer of Battle Once per short rest, add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see. Storm Warlock When you deal force, lightning, fire, or radiant damage with a psychic power, add +1 damage per die. Spirit Guardian Allies within 10 ft of you gain advantage on saving throws against fear while you are conscious.
